summary: The five throwables (14 Molotov, 65 M67 Frag, 2235 Stun, 2236 Smoke, 2237 Gas; all ITEM_CLASS 25078). The August client ships NO FireModes sheet and NO ProjectileDefinitions sheet, so the flight numbers here are Cranberry rulings (docs/120 s5); what IS the client's own is named CLIENT: the fire groups 7/42/43/44, the projectile models Projectile_*.adr, the MODEL ids 9440/9443/9468/9478/9480 (Models.txt) and the composite-effect ids (ActorCompositeEffectDefinitions.xml). D312 LIFTS docs/120 s5.0's exclusion of the owner's Z1 grenade table: the fuses, the effect ids, the model ids, the radii, the 10,000-bar blast and the gas tick are ADOPTED from C:/Z1/Server/Zone/ZoneCombatThrowables.cs under D315 (docs/125), and every one of the five effect ids and five model ids was checked to exist in August's own tables before it shipped. His two mechanisms still cross under D306 - a grenade always goes off, and the fallback spares the thrower.

rows.source: ClientItemDatasheetData.txt row 65: WEAPON_ID 1404, FIRE_GROUP_ID 0 - the only throwable whose datasheet names no group. The group is named after its own WEAPON_ID, which no datasheet group (1..90) can collide with.
rows.note: Modes 2808/2809 by D159. Timings copy the other three grenades' datasheet row (REFIRE 150, RELOAD 950, CLIP 1) because the frag's own row is 0/0/1.

rows.source: docs/120 s3.3 - the client's own ProjectileToPenTypes.txt names 14 ids (19000, 19002, 70038..70075) and no grenade; a throwable's projectile id is 71000 + its item id
rows.note: Any id the server names is the id the client uses; the base keeps the five clear of the client's own 700xx block and readable in a dump (71014, 71065, 73235, 73236, 73237).

rows.source: Z1's own projectile rows for the five grenades (C:/Z1/Server/Data/projectileDefinitions.json ids 70178-70182: SPEED 30, GRAVITY 1.2, DRAG 0), adopted under D312; SPEED (rec+0x5c) is the launch velocity FUN_140c7bb60:390-413 multiplies the aim vector by
rows.note: Was Cranberry's 18 (D301). At 18 the 2026-09-04 20:23 gas grenade met the ground 190 ms after leaving the hand and rested 9 m out. CRANBERRY_THROWABLE_SPEED retunes.

rows.source: Z1's own grenade projectile rows (ids 70178-70182) carry GRAVITY 1.2 (rec+0xa4, the ProjectileDefinitions loader's GRAVITY, docs/120 s3.2), adopted under D312
rows.note: A multiplier on the physics flight model's gravity, not an acceleration; 1.0 (the client's constructor preset) was D301's value and is what a bullet record still ships at +0xa4.

rows.source: docs/120 s3.2 - ANGULAR_VELOCITY_{X,Y,Z}_{MIN,MAX} (rec+0x104..+0x118) are read by ProjectileCallbackPhysics::OnActorReady (FUN_1415b17a0:42-55) as three lerped (min,max) pairs
rows.note: The grenade tumbles in flight: each axis gets (-6, +6). 0 would fly it rigid.

rows.source: User request 2026-09-08: faster stun, smoke and gas activation; docs/gameplay-20260908.md
rows.note: Tuning trial: frag 3 s, stun 1 s, smoke 1 s, gas 2 s, molotov contact with 1.5 s backstop. These are not claimed retail measurements.

rows.source: docs/120 s2.2 - FUN_142293af0 reads FIRE_DURATION_MS (rec+0x38) on a TYPE-12 trigger press and returns without entering the throw state (0x10) when it is < 1
rows.note: The throw's wind-up window in ms; the client's own datasheet carries no FIRE_DURATION for any weapon. CRANBERRY_THROWABLE_WINDUP_MS retunes.

rows.source: User request 2026-09-08: reduce excess grenade activation wait
rows.note: 150 ms allowance for the final position report, replacing the additional 1500 ms wait.

rows.source: Z1's EXPLOSION_CHARACTER_RADIUS = 5 world units - the radius his own server has hurt players at.
rows.note: Replaces D308's 8.0. The client's effect NAME still says 08m and the effect still draws that big - the 8 m was the size of the picture, and 5 u is how far it hurts on the server the owner plays.

rows.source: Z1's ExplosionBaseDamage = 10,000 on a 10,000-unit bar, i.e. 100 hp at the centre - the same number Cranberry already ruled.
rows.note: Unchanged in value, re-sourced to the owner's server. The FALL-OFF changes: see AugustThrowables.ExplosionFalloffPivotUnits.

rows.source: Z1's GasRadiusUnits = 7.
rows.note: Replaces D308's 6.0. Two units WIDER than the blast, not narrower: a cloud you have to run out of.

rows.source: Z1's GasDamagePerTick = 500 on a 10,000-unit bar = 5 hp, once per GasTickMs.
rows.note: Unchanged in value, re-sourced to the owner's server.

The one place D315 does not follow the owner's table, named here so a revert is one row.

rows.source: ActorCompositeEffectDefinitions.xml id 5301 PFX_Impact_Explosion_FragGrenade_Default_08m - present in August's own table, and the id Z1 plays for item 65.
rows.note: Replaces D307's 1873 (the _Dirt_08m variant). Picking Dirt was a ruling made because this server has no surface probe; the client's own Default variant is the surface-agnostic one and is what the owner's working server plays, so docs/120 O7 is settled without a material trigger.

rows.source: ActorCompositeEffectDefinitions.xml id 4658 PFX_Impact_Explosion_FlashGrenade_Default - checked present in August's own table; the same id Z1 plays for items 2235/2416.
rows.note: Unchanged by D315: Cranberry had already picked the id the owner's server plays. The screen flash stays docs/120 O6.

rows.note: Unchanged by D315. A loop, so it rides an effect TAG on a cloud anchor (0f 15 / 0f 16), not a one-shot.

rows.source: ActorCompositeEffectDefinitions.xml id 2335 PFX_Impact_GrenadePoison_loop - checked present in August's own table; the same id Z1 plays for items 2237/3022.

rows.note: Replaces D307's 190 (PFX_Fire_Molotov). 190 is the fire itself; 5308 is the IMPACT, which is what a bottle breaking on the ground is.

rows.source: ActorCompositeEffectDefinitions.xml id 192 PFX_Fire_Molotov_Persist (FX 1087 + SOUND 6351)
rows.note: The burning patch (an effect tag on the cloud anchor for MolotovSeconds).

rows.source: August's own Models.txt: 9443 Projectile_Grenades_HEGrenade.adr, 9478 Projectile_Grenades_FlashBang.adr, 9468 Projectile_Grenades_SmokeGrenade.adr, 9480 Projectile_Grenades_GasGrenade.adr, 9440 Projectile_MolotovCocktail.adr - each row's MODEL_FILE_NAME is byte-identical to the string AugustThrowables already carries.
rows.note: The numeric id of the mesh, which is what an AddLightweightNpc actorModelId takes and what Z1 spawns a grenade with. Order: frag, stun, smoke, gas, molotov - the same order as FuseSeconds. All five checked present in August before adoption.

rows.source: Z1's OnExplosiveHit as his server implements it: damage = base inside one unit, base / distance beyond it.
rows.note: Replaces D308's linear ramp to zero at the radius. Inverse-distance is harsher near the centre and gentler at the rim: 100 hp inside 1 u, 50 at 2 u, 20 at 5 u. The radius still cuts it off.

rows.source: Z1's DestroyAfterMs = 30,000, unconditional.
rows.note: A hard ceiling on a live grenade. Nothing should reach it - the fuse plus the D306 grace settles every throw long before - so a reap at 30 s is a leak alarm and is logged as one.

rows.source: Z1's SpawnRangeUnits = 200 - getClientsInRange(200, position), who gets told a grenade exists.
rows.note: How far a detonation's own 0f 43 reaches. A viewer further away than this is not told, which is also what keeps a full lobby's grenades off the wire.
